_comment: token: create one at Account Settings -> Tokens. The Vercel CLI's session is not used — it expires within hours. Keep this file chmod 600.
_token_comment: Vercel account token; leave empty to read the named environment variable.
_token_env_comment: Environment variable that holds the Vercel token.
_teams_comment: Vercel team identifiers to include. Leave it empty and every team the token can see is covered — the widget lists them itself on start, so a team you join appears without editing anything. Name teams here only to narrow it to those. The personal account alone is the fallback, not the default: it is what you get when there is no token, or when the token can see no teams. If listing them fails or stops early the board says so rather than quietly showing less.
_projects_comment: Project identifiers to include; empty includes every project in scope.
